descriptions.text: Enchanted Shuriken of Bloodlust (x100) Small, low-damage throwing stars. These bad boys aren't anything special upon first glance. They're the same black stars you wannabe ninjas purchased at the knife shop and the swap meet when you were kids. The same throwing stars you'd drill into the drywall of your room until your mom caught you and took them away. And while these shuriken don't have the ability to turn you into a ninja, nor do they have the capacity to make your mom stop drinking, they are enchanted with a Bloodlust enhancement. For every monster you damage with a shuriken from this set, the damage against that monster type rises by 8%.

recap.text: Mordecai confirms the Bloodlust on the hundred ninja stars compounds at eight percent, though the stars are very fragile. Brandon, Chris and Carl spend five minutes throwing fifty into the redoubt's pitted wooden table cover, and only about twenty stay unbroken. In the fight a tuskling rolls onto the glowing stars, and Carl stamps it deeper until its health plummets. He salvages every star, and his inventory grows a tab labelled Worthless Garbage.

beats.headline: A pile of ninja stars
beats.text: The boss box holds a pile of ninja stars, a hundred of them, the same black stars every wannabe ninja once drilled into his bedroom drywall. They are enchanted with Bloodlust: for every monster damaged with one, the damage against that monster type rises by eight percent. Carl asks Mordecai whether that means eight percent of the original amount or eight percent compounded, because that is a big deal after a while. Huh, says Mordecai, and checks. Good news: it is compounded. The bad news is that the stars are very fragile. Carl suspects it is not that great an enchantment, with only a hundred of them to throw and collect.
beats.gist: Carl finds a hundred fragile ninja stars that raise damage eight percent per monster hit, compounded.

beats.headline: Spikes on the redoubt
beats.text: Brandon reads the description and is awed: compounding damage means poke something two hundred times and it's literally millions of points. So he, Chris and Carl spend a good five minutes throwing fifty of the stars deep into the pitted wooden cover of the redoubt's front table, black spikes to pierce the boss each time it hits. Only about twenty stay unbroken. In the fight the star-covered tabletop lies broken, and a tuskling rolls onto the stars still glowing red, squealing, so Carl stamps it deeper into the wood. Its health drops slowly, then plummets as the exponential bonus kicks in.
beats.gist: Brandon, Chris and Carl throw fifty stars into a table, then Carl stamps a tuskling onto them.

beats.headline: Every star salvaged
beats.text: Imani drops a find on the floor in disgust, and Donut hops over and takes it into her own inventory. Everything, right? she asks, and Carl nods. He salvages all the ninja stars he can find and all the remaining pieces of the redoubt, and his inventory grows a new tab labelled Worthless Garbage. Then he spends a few minutes quietly looking round the arena for the remains of the party that went before them.
beats.gist: Carl salvages every ninja star and redoubt piece, then looks for the earlier party's remains.
